y-m-71-04.title: Kana tikapatsanura mativi ese ne a, b = c here?
y-m-71-04.goal: Ratidza ne counterexample kuti dot products dzakaenzana hadzioni kuti ma vectors maviri akaenzana, uye uwane kuti mangani asara kana chimwe chimiro chehukuru chawedzerwa.
y-m-71-04.material: Ma plane vectors i a = (2, 1) ne c = (1, 3). Jisu akati, 'Sezvo a · b = a · c, kupatsanura mativi ese ne a kunopa b = c.' (Poinzi inoreva dot product.) b ine chimiro b = (b1, b2) uye zvikamu zvayo i real numbers.
y-m-71-04.thinking.0: Kuedza kana mitemo yekuverenga ne nhamba ichigona kutamisirwa zvakananga ku dot product yema vectors
y-m-71-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira ma vectors akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro
y-m-71-04.thinking.2: Kufungisisa nezve huwandu hwemhinduro kana mamiriro awedzerwa
y-m-71-04.prereq.0: Fungidziro: basa iri rakagadzirwa padanho repamusoro rehigh school, kugadziriswa mushure mekudzidza elective course 'Geometry' (conic sections, plane vectors, solids ne space coordinates); 'H3' i label yekunetsa yeseti iyi yekugadzira chete uye hazvireve kuti course yakagoverwa kugiredhi rakati. Component form ye plane vectors, kuverenga dot product ne components, hukuru hwe vector
y-m-71-04.s.s1.prompt: Nzira yakasimba zvikuru yekutarisa kana mhedziso yaJisu 'b = c' ichigara ichishanda i ipi?
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzirisa a · b = a · c mu components uye uinyore se equation pakati pe b1 ne b2.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza b imwe inogutsa equation iyoyo uye uienzanise ne c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.a: Isa b dzakawanda uye uone kana dzose i b = c
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.a: Kuunganidza mienzaniso nekutarisa idzo dzinoenderana chete hakugone kuratidza 'nguva dzose'. Kunyanya, mienzaniso yaunosarudza inogona kuva yakarerekera kudivi rimwe.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.b: Tarisa kuti sezvo a isiri zero vector, tinogona kupatsanura mativi ese
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakatamisa mutemo wekubvisa unoshandiswa mukuwanza nhamba zvakananga ku dot product. Dot product i operation inoshandura ma vectors kuita nhamba.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.c: Tsvaga b ine a · b = a · c uye b ≠ c
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti kuputsa 'nguva dzose', muenzaniso mumwe unogutsa mamiriro asi une mhedziso isina kururama wakakwana.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.d: Tanga waenzanisa kana b ne c zvine hukuru hwakafanana
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.d: Kuva nehukuru hwakafanana i mamiriro anodiwa e b = c, asi unofanira kutanga watarisa kana zvichitevera kubva pamamiriro akapiwa.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.explain: Kuputsa 'inogara ichishanda', muenzaniso mumwe unogutsa mamiriro a · b = a · c apo b ≠ c wakakwana.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.prompt: Isa b = (b1, b2) 3 dzakasiyana dzine zvikamu ze integer dzinogutsa a · b = a · c asi b ≠ c. (|b1| ≤ 5)
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga waverenga mutengo we a · c nekuisa c, wobva wanyora a · b mu components uye uaaite akaenzana.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza b1 uye utarise kuti b2 inosarudzwa sei, wobva watarisa kuti b yakasiyana ne c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a · b inoenzana ne a · c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a · b haienzani ne a · c (= 5).
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b yakafanana ne c. Wana vector yakasiyana.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.explain: a · c = 2·1 + 1·3 = 5, saka zvakakwana kuti 2b1 + b2 = 5. Pane dzakawanda sezvaunoda, sa (0, 5), (2, 1), (3, −1). Ma b ese akadaro ane chikamu chakafanana nowe c munzira ye a uye anosiyana muchikamu perpendicular ku a chete.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukawedzerawo |b| = |c| (hukuru hwe b hwakaenzana nehukuru hwe c), pane ma b mangani dzose ane a · b = a · c uye b ≠ c? (Zvikamu i real numbers.)
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa b2 = 5 − 2b1 mu b1² + b2² = 10 kugadzira expression mu b1.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana c pachayo iri pakati pemhinduro dzakawanikwa uye uibvise.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.a: Wakafunga kuti b = c ndiyo yega. Gadzirisa ma equations maviri pamwe chete uye uverenge kuti mitengo yeb1 mingani inobuda.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.b: Wakaziva kuti mamiriro maviri anenge asarudza b. Kana ukagadzirisa zvakananga, imwe yasara kunze kwe b = c.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.c: Wakaenzanisa nemhinduro 2 dze equations mbiri. Wakatarisa kana imwe yazvo i c pachayo here?
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.d: Wakatamisa mhedziso kana pane mamiriro mamwe chete. Sezvo pane equation imwe yakawedzerwa, gadzirisa kuti mhinduro dzinochinja sei.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.explain: Kubatanidza 2b1 + b2 = 5 ne b1² + b2² = 10 kunopa (1, 3) ne (3, −1). (1, 3) i c pachayo, saka b yega yakasiyana ne c i (3, −1). b iyi i vector c yakaitwa reflection kuyambuka mutsetse unoenda munzira ye a.

y-m-71-08.title: Zvichienderana nenzvimbo yepoinzi, ma tangents mangani anogona kudhirowwa?
y-m-71-08.goal: Fanofungidzira uye ugadzirise huwandu hwe tangents dzinogona kudhirowwa kubva papoinzi iri kunze, pa, nemukati me parabola y² = 4x, uye utsanangure kuti tangent ipi inosiiwa nemhinduro inotora slope seletter.
y-m-71-08.material: Funga parabola y² = 4x (y squared equals four x). Vertex ndi O(0, 0). Tinoda kutsvaga ma tangent lines mangani anogona kudhirowwa kuparabola iyi kubva papoinzi A pa coordinate plane. Kana poinzi iri pa parabola, tinoverenga tangent line inopfuura napoinzi iyoyo. Kureba hakuna ma units.
y-m-71-08.thinking.0: Kufanofungidzira huwandu hwe tangents kubva panzvimbo yepoinzi
y-m-71-08.thinking.1: Kuchinja kutonga kana poinzi itsva yaonekwa
y-m-71-08.prereq.0: Fungidziro: basa iri rakagadzirwa pa advanced high-school level, kugadziriswa mushure mekudzidza elective course 'Geometry' (conic sections, plane vectors, solids ne space coordinates); 'H3' inongova label yekuoma yeboka iri rekugadzira uye haireve kuti course yakagoverwa kugiredhi rakati. Standard form ye parabola, equation ye tangent (tangent ine slope m ine chimiro y = mx + 1/m), discriminant ye quadratic equation
y-m-71-08.s.s1.prompt: Mapoinzi anoratidzwa rimwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, fanofungidzira huwandu hwe tangents dzinogona kudhirowwa kubva papoinzi iyoyo.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.0: Isa ma coordinates epoinzi mu y² = 4x uye uenzanise kuti ndeipi yakakura pakati pe y² ne 4x.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora tangent ine slope m se y = mx + 1/m, isa ma coordinates epoinzi kuti ugadzire equation mu m, uye utarise chiratidzo che discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma tangents mangani anogona kudhirowwa kubva ku A kuenda kuparabola?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Tangent y = mx + 1/m inopfuura na A(1, 3) inogutsa 3 = m + 1/m, ndiko kuti m² − 3m + 1 = 0, ine discriminant 5, iri positive, saka pane ma slopes maviri. Poinzi iri kunze, saka pane ma tangents 2.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakafunga kuti pane tangent imwe chete. Edza kana unogona kutsvaga ma slopes maviri akasiyana e tangents dzinopfuura napoinzi.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hauna kusiyanisa kana poinzi iri kunze kana mukati me parabola. Funga kuti tangents dzinogona kudhirowwa kubva padivi ripi.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ndangariro yekuti pane ma tangents maviri kubva papoinzi iri kunze nekuenzanisa nzvimbo yepoinzi zvinoenderana.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ma tangents mangani anogona kudhirowwa kubva ku B?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Tangent inopfuura na B(1, 2) inogutsa 2 = m + 1/m, ndiko kuti (m − 1)² = 0, saka pane slope imwe chete (m = 1). Kubva papoinzi iri pa parabola pane tangent 1.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatonga kuti kubva papoinzi iri pa parabola pane tangent iri papoinzi iyoyo chete.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakatora mhedziso yepoinzi iri kunze. Poinzi iyi iri paparabola, saka nzvimbo yakachinja.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kubva papoinzi iri paparabola pane mutsetse unobata papoinzi iyoyo. Ongorora kana pane mutsetse unobata unopfuura nepoinzi.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mitsetse inobata mingani inogona kudhirowa kubva paC?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Mutsetse unobata unopfuura neC(4, 1) unoita 1 = 4m + 1/m, ndiko kuti, 4m² − m + 1 = 0, uye discriminant i1 − 16 < 0, saka hapana chiyero. Kubva papoinzi iri mukati, hapana mutsetse unobata unogona kudhirowa.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatora mhedziso yepoinzi iri paparabola. Poinzi iyi haipo paparabola.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatonga kuti ipoinzi iri mukati meparabola, saka hapana mitsetse inobata zvachose.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakatora mhedziso yepoinzi iri kunze. Enzanisa hukuru hwe 4x ne y² kuongorora kana iri mukati.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.reflect: Nhamba dzemitsetse inobata pamapoinzi matatu dzaiva 2, 1 ne0. Ungataura sei nzvimbo yepoinzi nekuenzanisa hukuru hwe y² ne 4x? Fungidzirawo kuti kuenzanisa uku kunobatana sei nechiratidzo chediscriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.prompt: Mitsetse inobata mingani inogona kudhirowa kuparabola kubva papoinzi D(0, 3)? Wana unyore mitsetse yose inobata, uye uenzanise kana izvi zvichienderana nemugumisiro wekugadzirisa kunogadzika chiyero se m.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti equation a·m² − b·m + 1 = 0 mu m inochinja sei kana x-coordinate yeD i0.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga mitsetse inobata mingani yawakawana kubva mumutaurire mu m, uye udhirowe mitsetse inopfuura nepoinzi D munzira dzakasiyana kuona kana pane mimwe mitsetse inosangana neparabola papoinzi imwe chete.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ndakatsanangura nemashoko angu kuti equation inochinja sei mukugadzirisa kunogadzika chiyero se m here?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakasiyanisa mutsetse unobata une chiyero nemutsetse unobata wechiyero chisingagoni kushandiswa here?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ndakaongorora kuti mitsetse inobata yandakanyora inopfuura chaizvo nepoinzi D(0, 3) here?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.0: 2. Kuisa (0, 3) mu y = mx + 1/m kunopa 3 = 1/m, saka mutsetse mumwe chete unobata y = x/3 + 3 une chiyero 1/3 ndiwo unobuda, asi y-axis (x = 0), isina chiyero, inewo mutsetse unobata pavertex, saka pamwe chete pane 2.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.1: Pane mitsetse miviri inobata. Izvi zvinogoneka nokuti poinzi D iri kunze kweparabola, uye mumwe i x = 0 neimwe i y = (1/3)x + 3. x = 0 haigoni kunyorwa muchimiro y = mx + n, saka inoshaikwa nekugadzirisa kunoshandisa chiyero.

y-m-71-01.title: Pane poinzi imwe chete iri panhambwe 10 kubva pakati here?
y-m-71-01.goal: Mumhinduro inotsvaga mapoinzi uchishandisa mamiriro echinhambwe kubva papoinzi iri paparabola kuenda kufocus, tsvaga mutsetse wakashayikwa kuenzana, uye utsvage iwe pachako kuti mapoinzi mangani anosangana namamiriro zvose.
y-m-71-01.material: Funga parabola y² = 8x (rirevere: y sikweya yakaenzana masere x) pacoordinate plane. Ngati F ive focus yeparabola iyi, uye poinzi P(x, y) ive poinzi iri paparabola. Mudzidzi akagadzirisa dambudziko rokutsvaga mapoinzi ose P ane chinhambwe PF chakaenzana ne 10 sezvinoratidzwa pazasi. Zvikamu zvemacoordinate zvakafanana, uye kureba kwakanyorwa pasina zvikamu.
y-m-71-01.thinking.1: Kutsvaga kuti mapoinzi mangani anosangana namamiriro
y-m-71-01.thinking.2: Kutonga kana mhinduro iripo kubva pamhando yekukosha kunogoneka
y-m-71-01.prereq.0: Pfungwa: basa iri rakaiswa panhanho yepamusoro yechikoro chepamusoro, kuti rigadziriswe mushure mokudzidza chidzidzo chinosarudzwa 'Geometry' (conic sections, ma vector eplane, zvinhu zvakasimba nemacoordinate echadenga); 'H3' chiratidzo chokuoma cheboka rokugadzira iri chete uye hachireve kuti chidzidzo chakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Tsananguro yeparabola (focus ne directrix), focus ne directrix yechimiro y²=4px, fomula yechinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa chirevo chomutsetse wega wega zvakananga mumutsetse unotevera, uye uenzanise kana huwandu hwenyaya hwakadzikira kana wakabva pamutsetse wapamberi kuenda kumutsetse wapashure.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kukosha kwose kunogona kutorwa na y kana x = 8 yaiswa muchirevo cheparabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.0: Kubva pachimiro y² = 4px, 4p = 8, saka p = 2, focus F ndi (2, 0), uye directrix ndi x = −2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.1: Kupoinzi P(x, y) iri paparabola, PF yakaenzana nechinhambwe kubva ku P kuenda kudirectrix, saka PF = x + 2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.2: PF = 10, saka x + 2 = 10, ndiko kuti, x = 8.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.3: y² = 8 · 8 = 64, saka y = 8, uye poinzi chete inosangana namamiriro ndi P(8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.4: Saka poinzi P ine PF = 10 ndi (8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.explain: Mitsetse 1 kusvika 3 yakarurama. Mumutsetse 4, kana y² = 64 saka y = 8 kana y = −8. Parabola yakaenzana padivi peaksi ye x, saka mapoinzi ose mbiri (8, 8) ne (8, −8) anosangana namamiriro. Mutsetse 5 wakangogara nhaka yokusiiwa komutsetse 4.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapoinzi 2 akasiyana P(x, y) paparabola ane macoordinate ari nhamba dzizere anosangana na PF = 10. (Focus F ndi (2, 0).)
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora hukama pakati pe x ne y sechirevo uchishandisa mamiriro okuti poinzi iri paparabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza x imwe, utarise kana y ichibuda senhamba yakazara, uye uverenge zvakananga chinhambwe kubva papoinzi iyoyo kuenda ku F.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.explain: Mapoinzi chete anogutsa mamiriro ese maviri i (8, 8) ne (8, −8). x yakasimbiswa semutengo mumwe uye simbi ye y chete ine mikana miviri.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.prompt: Mapoinzi mangani P pa parabola imwechete ane PF = 1?
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora PF se expression mu x uye utarise range yemitengo inogona kutorwa ne x kumapoinzi ari pa parabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga zvakananga dhuri kubva pa vertex O(0, 0) kuenda ku F.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.a: Poinzi imwe. Vertex O i poinzi yakadaro
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.a: Kana uchiverenga PF pa vertex zvakananga, haisi 1. Wakafungidzira poinzi iri padyo zvikuru usina kuverenga.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.b: Mbiri. Mapoinzi maviri akaenzana kutenderedza x-axis
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakatamisa mhedziso ye 'mapoinzi maviri akaenzana' kubva kudanho rapfuura sezvayakaita. Unofanira kutanga watarisa kana mutengo we x unogoneka.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.c: Hazvigone kuzivikanwa. Hazvigone kusarudzwa kubva pachimiro oga
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.c: Expression PF = x + 2 inokubvumira kusarudza range yemitengo inogoneka. Ichi hachisi chiitiko chekushaya ruzivo.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.d: Hapana. PF inogara i 2 kana kupfuura
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.d: x + 2 inova 2 pamutengo mudiki zvikuru unogona kutorwa ne x. Uku i kutonga kwakaongorora range inogoneka yedhuri.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.explain: PF = x + 2, uye pa parabola x ≥ 0, saka PF ≥ 2. Kuti PF = 1 taizoda x = −1, asi ipapo y² = −8 uye hapana real y. Mamiriro edhuri anogona kusava nemhinduro zvachose.

y-m-71-02.title: Mapoinzi ane huwandu hwedhuri husingachinji anogara ari ellipse here?
y-m-71-02.topic: Definition ye ellipse (huwandu hwedhuri kuenda kumapoinzi maviri)
y-m-71-02.goal: Wana mamiriro anodiwa kuti seti yemapoinzi ane huwandu hwedhuri husingachinji kuenda kumapoinzi maviri ive ellipse, uye utaure kuti chimiro chipi chinobuda kana mamiriro ashaikwa kana ari pamuganhu.
y-m-71-02.material: Pa coordinate plane pane mapoinzi maviri F(−4, 0) ne F'(4, 0) (verenga: F ne F prime). Dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri i 8. Poinzi P(x, y) inofamba kuti PF + PF' = s. Pano s i constant positive, uye hurefu hunonyorwa pasina yuniti.
y-m-71-02.prereq.0: Fungidziro: basa iri rakagadzirwa padanho repamusoro rehigh school, kugadziriswa mushure mekudzidza elective course 'Geometry' (conic sections, plane vectors, solids ne space coordinates); 'H3' i label yekunetsa yeseti iyi yekugadzira chete uye hazvireve kuti course yakagoverwa kugiredhi rakati. Definition nechimiro chakajairika che ellipse, dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri, hukama pakati pehurefu hwemativi matatu e triangle
y-m-71-02.s.s1.prompt: Tisingazivi mutengo we s, tinogona kutaura here kuti chimiro chinodhirowa nepoinzi P i ellipse?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mitengo mishoma pa s uye ugadzirise kana poinzi P yakadaro ichivapo zvachose.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora hukama hunoshanda pakati pehurefu hwemativi matatu kana mapoinzi P, F ne F' akabatanidzwa kuita triangle.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.a: Hatigone kutaura. Kana s i 8 kana kushoma, haisi ellipse
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.a: Wakaratidza kuti, pamusoro pe definition, s inofanira kuenzaniswa nedhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.b: Tinogona kutaura. Chero huwandu hwakagadzikana, inogara i ellipse
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakayeuka definition kusvika pa 'huwandu hwakagadzikana' chete. Wakambo enzanisa hukuru hwehuwandu nedhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri here?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.c: Hatigone kutaura. Inosarudzwa nenzvimbo dzemapoinzi maviri oga
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.c: s i constant yakasimbiswa uye inokanganisa chimiro. Edza kuti chii chinochinja kana ukachinja s.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.d: Tinogona kutaura. Chero s i nhamba positive ipi, P inovapo
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakatora 'P inovapo' ne 'i ellipse' sezvinhu zvimwechete. Kunyange kana ichivapo, chimiro chinogona kusava ellipse.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.explain: PF + PF' ≥ FF' = 8, saka kana s < 8 hapana poinzi P yakadaro, uye kana s = 8 mapoinzi ari pa segment FF'. I ellipse kana s > 8 chete. Saka ruzivo rwakawanda nezve s runodiwa.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana s = 10, isa mapoinzi 2 akasiyana P(x, y) ane ma coordinates e integer anogutsa PF + PF' = 10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekusarudza mapoinzi ari pa maaxes uye uverenge PF ne PF' pane rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kana huwandu hwemadhuri maviri kupoinzi yawakasarudza i hombe kupfuura 10, fambisa poinzi padyo nema foci maviri; kana i shoma, ifambise kure.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu hwemadhuri kuenda kumapoinzi maviri i 10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwemadhuri kuenda kumapoinzi maviri hahusi 10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.explain: Mapoinzi chete ane ma coordinates e integer i mapoinzi mana (5, 0), (−5, 0), (0, 3) ne (0, −3). Kutanga pa maaxes kunokubvumira kuwedzera madhuri pakarepo. Pane mapoinzi akawanda zvikuru pa ellipse asiri ma integers.

y-m-71-03.material: Funga hyperbola H: x²/9 − y²/16 = 1 (verenga: x squared over 9 minus y squared over 16 equals 1). Ma asymptotes e H i y = (4/3)x ne y = −(4/3)x. y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.a: Chirevo chinotaura nezvemitsetse inosangana 'papoinzi imwe chete'. Mutsetse unosangana pamapoinzi maviri hauzi chinhu chechirevo.

y-m-71-03.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pemitsetse px + qy = r, isa mitsetse 2 akasiyana inosangana ne H papoinzi imwe chaizvo asi isiri ma tangents. (|p|, |q| ≤ 20, |r| ≤ 100. Mutsetse mumwechete wakanyorwa nema integers proportional unoverengwa semutsetse mumwe.)
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvakare mutsetse muchimiro y = mx+k uye uuise mu equation ye H; verenga kana pane m inoita kuti coefficient ye x² mu expression mu x ive 0.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa m yakadaro ne slope yema asymptotes e H, uye unyore slope se ratio ye p ne q kuti p ne q ive ma integers.

y-m-71-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumhinduro yemudzidzi apo kururamisa kusina kukwana.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora ma equations emutsara 2 nemutsara 3 padivi pemumwe uye uenzanise kana ari ruzivo rwakasiyana.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana d = (0, 1, 0) ichigutsa mutsara 2 nemutsara 3 uye kana mutsara iwoyo uri perpendicular ku α.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.0: Rega direction vector yemutsara l ive d = (d1, d2, d3).
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.1: Iri perpendicular ku direction vector (1, 0, 0) ye m1, saka d1 = 0.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.2: Iri perpendicular zvakare ku direction vector (2, 0, 0) ye m2, saka 2 · d1 = 0.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.3: Kana mutsara uri perpendicular kumitsara miviri mu plane, uri perpendicular kuplane iyoyo, saka l ⟂ α.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.4: Saka d inofanira kuva nechimiro (0, 0, d3).
y-m-71-07.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 2 ne3 yakarurama, asi mutsara 3 ndi equation imwe chete nemutsara 2 (d1 = 0). Mutsara 4 unotaura, pasina mamiriro ayo, chinhu chinoshanda chete kana mitsara miviri mu plane isiri parallel kune mumwe. Saka mutsara 5 hauvimbisiwiwo zvakare.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.prompt: Isa ma direction vectors 3 ane integer components, ari munzira dzakasiyana, dzemitsara l apo d iri perpendicular kuma direction vectors e m1 ne m2 zvose asi l isiri perpendicular ku α. (|d2|, |d3| ≤ 5. Nzira imwe chete inoverengwa seimwe.)
y-m-71-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro e perpendicularity ne m1 ne m2 se ma equations mu components uye utarise kuti component ipi ye d yakagadziriswa.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti hukama hupi d inofanira kuva nahwo ne (0, 0, 1) kuti ive perpendicular ku α, uye usarudze ma components anoputsa hukama uhwo.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Iri perpendicular kuna m1 na m2.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Haisi perpendicular ku direction vector (1, 0, 0) ye m1.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Haisi parallel ne normal direction (0, 0, 1) ye α.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana d ine chimiro (0, 0, d3), iri perpendicular ku α, saka haisi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.explain: d = (0, 1, 0), (0, 1, 1), (0, 1, 2) dzose dzine d1 = 0 saka dziri perpendicular kuna m1 na m2, asi hadzisi parallel ne (0, 0, 1), saka hadzisi perpendicular ku α. Sezvo m1 ne m2 dziri parallel, ruzivo rumwe chete rwakashandiswa kaviri.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.prompt: Kuti upedzise l ⟂ α, ruzivo rupi rwunofanira kuwedzerwa kuruzivo rwuri pamusoro?
y-m-71-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora, kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, kana ichipa equation itsva pama components e d.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kana equation itsva iri ruzivo rumwe chete ne d1 = 0 kana ruzivo rwakasiyana.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.a: Iri perpendicular zvakare kune mumwe mutsara mu α unoenderana ne x-axis
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.a: Mutsara une nzira imwe chete na m1 na m2 haupe equation itsva. Enzanisa kana unotakura ruzivo rumwe chete nemitsara miviri yapfuura.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.b: l inopfuura napoinzi iri kunze kwe α
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.b: Nzvimbo yepoinzi haichinji equation ye direction vector. Unoda ruzivo rwenzira, kwete rwepoinzi inopfuurwa.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.c: Iri perpendicular zvakare kumutsara mu α usingaenderani ne x-axis
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.c: Wakanzwisisa kuti unoda ruzivo rwemutsara une nzira yakasiyana mu plane. Mitsara miviri isiri parallel iri mu plane imwe chete inosangana papoinzi imwe.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.d: l inosangana na m1 papoinzi imwe
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.d: Kuva nepoinzi yekusangana ndiruzivo rwenzvimbo. Haipi equation itsva nezve nzira.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.explain: Kana iri perpendicular kumitsara miviri isiri parallel mu plane, iri perpendicular kuplane. Semuenzaniso, kana iri perpendicular zvakare kunzira ye y-axis (0, 1, 0), saka d2 = 0 uye d = (0, 0, d3).

y-m-71-09.title: Kana yakaiswa, nzvimbo i cosθ nguva kana cos²θ nguva?
y-m-71-09.goal: Edza imwe yemamodel maviri nenhamba kuchimiro chakati, uye utsanangure kuti nei chikonzero che 'mativi ose anopfupika' chisina kururama nekuparadzanisa mativi akafanana nemutsetse umo maplane maviri anosangana nemativi perpendicular nawo.
y-m-71-09.material: Mumacoordinates espace, triangle ABC ine mavertices A(0, 0, 0), B(4, 0, 0), C(0, 4, 4). Kona θ pakati peplane yetriangle iyi ne xy-plane i45°, uye cos45° ≈ 0.707. Mumvuri (orthogonal projection) wetriangle iyi wakadonhedzwa perpendicular pa xy-plane itriangle ine mavertices A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C'(0, 4). Jihu akati, 'Hurefu hunopfupika kuita cosθ nguva, saka zvose upamhi nehurefu zvinopfupika, uye nzvimbo inova cos²θ nguva,' uye Seoa akati, 'Nzvimbo inova cosθ nguva.' Marefu akanyorwa pasina mayuniti.
y-m-71-09.thinking.1: Kuwana chikamu chisina simba muchirevo chinotsigira
y-m-71-09.prereq.0: Kufungidzira: basa iri rakaiswa pachiyero chepamusoro chechikoro chepamusoro, rigadziriswe mushure mekutodzidza kosi yekusarudza 'Geometry' (conic sections, plane vectors, zvakasimba nemacoordinates espace); 'H3' inongova chiratidzo chekuoma chebatch iyi yekugadzira uye haireve kuti kosi yakapiwa kugiredhi rakati. Macoordinates espace, kona pakati peplane mbiri, zvinoreva orthogonal projection nepfungwa dzekutanga dzehurefu nenzvimbo yakaiswa
y-m-71-09.s.s1.prompt: Nzvimbo yetriangle ABC i 8√2 ≈ 11.31 uye nzvimbo yeprojection i8. Muenzaniso mumwe uyu unogona kutiudza chii nezvezvirevo zviviri?
y-m-71-09.s.s1.hint.0: Isa θ = 45° mumaformula ezvirevo zviviri uye ufungidzire nzvimbo yeprojection kune imwe neimwe.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kukosha kuviri kwakafungidzirwa padivi nedivi nenzvimbo chaiyo yeprojection, 8.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.a: Cos²θ nguva yaJihu yakarurama. Nokuti 0.707 i cos²45°
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.a: cos²45° i0.5. Hauna kuongorora nekuverenga kuti 0.707 ikukosha kweformula ipi.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.b: Zvinoenderana ne cosθ nguva yaSeoa. Muenzaniso mumwe oga haisi humbowo, saka ndichaongororawo nemamwe michimiro
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakasimbisa kuti zvinoenderana nemodel yaSeoa ukafungawo nezvemuganhu wemuenzaniso mumwe chete.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.c: Zvirevo zvose zviviri hazvina kururama. Nokuti 0.707 yakasiyana ne cos45°
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.c: Hauna kuongorora kubva padata kuti cos45° inenge 0.707.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.d: Zvinoenderana ne cosθ nguva yaSeoa uye hazvienderani ne cos²θ nguva yaJihu
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaitwa nekuverenga kukosha kunofungidzirwa nemamodel maviri uye kuvaenzanisa nekukosha chaiko.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.explain: Ratio chaiyo 8 ÷ 8√2 ≈ 0.707 inoenzana ne cos45° ≈ 0.707 uye inosiyana ne cos²45° = 0.5. Muenzaniso mumwe uyu unoenderana nemodel yaSeoa, asi muenzaniso mumwe hauratidzi kuti unoshanda kumichimiro yose.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.acc.0: Zvinoenderana nemodel yaSeoa, uye nyevero yekuda kuongorora nemamwe michimiro nokuti muenzaniso mumwe chete yawedzerwa. Izvi zvinogamuchirwa pano.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.prompt: Heino chimiro chitsva. Rectangle PQRS ine mavertices P(0, 0, 0), Q(2, 0, 0), R(2, 3, 3), S(0, 3, 3). Divi PQ rine hurefu 2 uye richiri 2 mushure meprojection. Divi QR rine hurefu 3√2 uye ri3 mushure meprojection. Ungaongorora sei chikonzero chaJihu che 'marefu ose anopfupika kuita cosθ nguva' kuchimiro ichi?
y-m-71-09.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga wega ratio yehurefu hweprojection kuhurefu hwekutanga kune PQ nekune QR.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ongorora kana kuwanza maratio maviri kuchienzana neratio yenzvimbo.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.a: Hachishande. Pane divi umo hurefu hunoramba hwakafanana
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.a: Wakawana kubva padata kuti divi rinopfupika zvakadini rinosiyana zvichienderana nenzira yaro.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.b: Chinoshanda. Zvose PQ neQR zvinopfupika kana zvakaiswa
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.b: Hauna kuongorora kuti hurefu hwe PQ hunochinja sei. Hunoramba 2 kuenda ku2.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.c: Hachishande. Kana zvakaiswa, mativi ose anova marefu zvechokwadi
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.c: Hapana divi rinova refu. Enzanisa hurefu hwekutanga nehurefu hweprojection kune divi rega rega.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.d: Hazvigoni kutongwa. Irectangle, saka rakasiyana netriangle yekutanga
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.d: Kunyange kana zita rechimiro rakasiyana, unogona kuenzanisa hurefu hwemativi. Iyi inyaya umo data rakakwana kutonga.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.explain: PQ iri parallel nemutsetse umo maplane maviri anosangana (x-axis), saka hurefu hwayo hunoramba hwakafanana, uye QR chete inopfupika kuita cosθ nguva (3√2 → 3). Saka chikonzero che 'mativi ose anova cosθ nguva' hachina kururama. Nzvimbo inoenda 6√2 → 6, inenge 0.707 nguva, yakafanana nemhedzisiro yekupfupika munzira imwe chete.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.prompt: Ungatsanangurira sei Jihu? Uchishandisa michimiro miviri iri pamusoro, nyora nenhamba kuti hurefu hwemativi hwakachinja sei uye nei nzvimbo i cosθ nguva kwete cos²θ nguva.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mutebhura hurefu hwe PQ ne QR pamberi napashure peprojection.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.hint.1: Kutarisa tebhura, nyora mumutsara mumwe kuti nzira ipi inopfupika uye ipi inoramba yakafanana.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakanyora nemashoko angu here kuti nzira imwe inoramba yakafanana uye imwe chete ndiyo inopfupika?
y-m-71-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nhamba dzandakanyora (semuenzaniso 8√2 → 8, 6√2 → 6, 2 → 2, 3√2 → 3) dzinoenderana nedata riri pamusoro here?
y-m-71-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakaenzanisa here kuti ratio yenzvimbo yaizova yei dai nzira dzose mbiri dzakapfupika?
y-m-71-09.s.s3.model.0: Nzira iri parallel nemutsetse umo maplane maviri anosangana, sa PQ, inochengeta hurefu kana yaiswa, uye nzira perpendicular nayo chete ndiyo inova cosθ nguva. Saka nzvimbo i cosθ nguva, kwete cos²θ nguva. Mumuenzaniso uyu futi, 6√2 inova 6, inenge 0.7 nguva.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.model.1: Divi PQ harina kuchinja kubva pa2 kuenda ku2. Divi QR chete ndiro rakapfupika kubva pa3√2 kuenda ku3, saka ratio i1/√2. Dai mativi ose maviri akapfupika, ratio yaifanira kuva 1/2, asi ratio chaiyo yenzvimbo i6/(6√2), inenge 0.7, saka haikodzeri.
